title: Casholoco Solo
description: Run a listed company, invest, negotiate and outsmart up to six rival CEOs. A complete single-player economic strategy game with classic, hexagonal and 3D island boards. French and English; no game server, no timer.
controls: Mouse or touch: choose decisions, buy shares, manage products and explore the board.
Click Ready to settle the quarter after saving your decisions.
Use Home to keep your game in this browser; Save lets you copy and import its text.
